_comment: SYNTHETIC: app-scoped context_connections page in the server's shape. Connections are application-typed rows narrowed to assetType AIModelConnection; on an app-scoped query a connection the app uses is a referenced row (isReferenced true, assetKey/ownerAppKey = the visiting app) identified by its own key/name. The server never sets producerAssetKey/producerAssetName on agent or connection rows.
